name: rentgen
description: Point your phone at your stuff; an agent prices its resale + rent-per-day value and adds up your idle capital. SDK-first, client-side, zero backend.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rentgen/sdk && npm run build -w app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rentgen/sdk && npm run typecheck -w app
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx -y vercel link --yes --project rentgen --cwd apps/app/dist && npx -y vercel deploy --prod --yes --cwd apps/app/dist
